selected.rationale: The Pet Parent explicitly focuses on pet health and treats their pet as a family member, aligning directly with our senior dog food's subcategories of pet_health and senior_dogs. Furthermore, their preference for 'vet-recommended' and 'ingredient transparency' messaging matches our vet-formulated, grain-free advertiser profile.

The Wellness Optimizer views health through a systematic lens and is willing to pay premiums for evidence-backed products, perfectly matching our science-backed value proposition and premium price tier. Their affinity for supplements and organic grocery translates naturally to functional, vet-formulated senior dog nutrition.

The Busy Parent is time-poor, convenience-motivated, and loves subscriptions, which directly complements our subscription-based business model for dog food. Their mid-tier price sensitivity and preference for trusted brands match our estimated $60 AOV and quality-focused positioning.

rejected.reason: The Gen Z Aesthete focuses heavily on fast fashion, beauty, and functional beverages, with a disinterest in performance claims without vibe, which conflicts with our science-backed senior dog food brand.
The Affluent Classic focuses on classic apparel, travel, and home goods rather than pet care, making their core categories irrelevant to dog nutrition.
The Sustainability Buyer focuses primarily on sustainable apparel, clean beauty, and refillable products rather than specialized pet health and senior nutrition.
The Convenience-First Millennial defaults to instant delivery and quick commerce for personal convenience rather than long-term pet health and specialized senior dog subscriptions.
The Value-Conscious Shopper has high price sensitivity and looks for discount-forward bundles, which clashes with our premium-tier, $60 AOV pricing model.
The Fitness Enthusiast focuses on personal activewear, supplements, and recovery for humans rather than canine health or senior dog care.
The Gifter is explicitly disinterested in subscription-only products, which directly contradicts our subscription-based business model.
